model.support: one-aircraft fixed sub-missions of four hours; 25% outbound and 25% return fractions; half-hour post-mission turnround
model.execute: one-aircraft continuous mission from hour 8 to 14.25
model.dependency: EXECUTE continuously depends on the SUPPORT profile instance beginning at hour 8; MUTD=N

excluded_diagnostic.reason: The frozen v1.0.0 prediction that DTTOL=0 aborts EXECUTE at first regenerative child completion was contradicted: it suspended from 12 to 12.5, resumed, and succeeded at 14.25. The native observation is retained as diagnostic, not retroactively accepted under that contract.

predeclared_acceptance: Each fresh run uses session-0 SSH, the global native mutex, and GUI PID 13340 identity guard; source and raw bytes are hash-sealed before/after. Every source imports/exports its 14 or 15 populated business tables exactly, converts with zero errors and yields valid SXO, event log and JSON report.

All regenerative runs launch SUPPORT children at 8 and 12.5 after a first completion at 12 and a half-hour turnround, creating a half-hour submission gap. Both children succeed/complete by 14.5; EXECUTE launches at 8 and reaches planned completion at 14.25.

At DTTOL=0 the regenerative-dependent EXECUTE suspends 12–12.5, then resumes and succeeds at 14.25. At DTTOL=0.51 it has no positive gap suspension and succeeds at 14.25; the no-row control also has no gap suspension.

The fixed SUPPORT mission launches at 8 and succeeds/completes at 12. Fixed-control EXECUTE succeeds at 14.25; with DTTOL=0.51 dependency it aborts at 12 despite tolerance and has no 14.25 success. A same-time zero-duration suspension/resume at hour 8 may occur in the dependent fixed run and is not counted as positive suspended exposure.

All runs have 32 aligned half-hour SystemResults and StockTotalResults bins, two-aircraft conservation and terminal ready two. The regenerative control/tolerant/zero runs have 12.25/12.25/11.75 aircraft operating hours and 0/0/0.5 suspended hours; each has one aircraft-hour of SUPPORT turnround. Fixed control/tolerant have 10.25/8 operating hours, zero positive suspended hours and half an aircraft-hour of SUPPORT turnround. No failures, corrective repair, PM or stock movement occur.

ResultSummary factors, per-mission events, both aircraft identities, allocation, return/turnround and terminal ledgers are verified against raw outputs. A separate read-only reviewer replays these assertions without importing the author checker.
limits: One installed executable, seed, unit, two-aircraft schedule, half-hour turnround and two tolerance values; no general DTTOL law.
The zero-tolerance regenerative gap suspends in this setup; no general abort rule, same-time internal priority, failures, shortages, GUI visuals or cross-engine equivalence is established.
